findings_addressed.oracle: QTimer.isActive() is an independent behavioral oracle: it reflects the actual running state of the Qt timer object, entirely separate from the button text string. After toggle-on the timer must be active (start() called); after toggle-off it must be inactive (stop() called). This is verified by reading _on_auto_refresh_toggled in threads_tab.py lines 429-434 which calls start() and stop() on the timer alongside setText().
